app.name: Moziki
app.offlineHint: You can keep working. New transactions will sync automatically when the connection returns.
app.footer: Moziki · Built for cooperatives in the DRC

auth.subtitle: Sign in to your cooperative's ledger.
auth.demoHint: Development only — seeded automatically by the backend.
auth.featureLedgerBody: Debits and credits must match before anything is saved.
auth.featureAuditBody: Every action is written to an append-only audit trail.
auth.featureOfflineBody: Keep recording on a weak network; sync catches up safely.
auth.heroBody: A shared double-entry ledger for savings groups, Likelemba and cooperatives. Built for trust, designed for weak networks.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.subtitle: Here is where the cooperative stands today.
dashboard.emptyRecent: No transactions yet. Post the first one to start the journal.
dashboard.integrityBody: Every posting is checked twice: in the service and by PostgreSQL. Total debits must equal total credits, always.
dashboard.memberViewHint: Showing cooperative totals and your personal balance.

transactions.title: Transactions
transactions.subtitle: An immutable journal of every franc that moves.
transactions.emptyAll: The journal is empty. Post the first transaction.
transactions.reverseReasonPlaceholder: Explain why this entry must be reversed…
transactions.reversedNotice: This transaction was reversed. The entry remains in the journal.
transactions.offlineQueued: Saved offline. It will be posted automatically when the connection returns.
transactions.doubleEntryNote: Debits and credits are written together. Once posted, the entry cannot be edited.
transactions.reversalSuccess: Reversal posted. The original entry is preserved in the journal.
transactions.noMembers: No members yet. Add a member before posting this transaction.
transactions.channelHint: How the money was received or paid

members.title: Members
members.subtitle: The people who make this cooperative work.
members.passwordHint: At least 8 characters. Share it privately with the member.
members.success: Member onboarded and savings/shares accounts opened.

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.subtitle: The cooperative chart of accounts, backed by the journal.

audit.title: Audit trail
audit.subtitle: Who did what, when — permanently recorded.
audit.accountabilityBody: Every login, member onboarding and ledger posting is recorded. Entries cannot be edited or deleted, not even by a leader.

common.invalidAmount: Enter a valid amount greater than zero.
common.networkError: Cannot reach the server. Check your connection.

accountability.title: Accountability
accountability.subtitle: The daily cash count, the journal and the audit trail in one place.
accountability.memberSubtitle: See how your leaders reconcile the cooperative's cash and mobile money.
accountability.formBody: Declare what you physically counted. The ledger snapshot is frozen with your report, so later postings cannot rewrite it.
accountability.notesPlaceholder: Explain a difference, handover or incident…
accountability.formNote: Submitted reports are append-only. A correction creates a new revision.
accountability.memberView: Only a leader can submit the count. Every member can see the latest result, the differences and the audit activity — never IP addresses or internal metadata.
accountability.historyHint: Newest business day first; corrections appear as new revisions.
accountability.activityHint: A safe, member-facing view of recent audit events.
accountability.privacyNote: Counts, differences and audit events are shared with all members. IP addresses, user agents and raw metadata stay in the leader/auditor audit trail.
accountability.successBalanced: Count submitted. Cash and mobile money match the ledger.
accountability.successDiscrepancy: Count submitted with a discrepancy. Members and auditors can now see it.
accountability.invalidCount: Enter valid non-negative amounts with at most two decimals.
accountability.pendingNotice: {{count}} correction(s) awaiting auditor review. Members still see the last approved count.
accountability.reviewQueueHint: Approve a correction to make it the authoritative count for that day.
accountability.reviewNotePlaceholder: Reason or auditor note (required to reject)
accountability.reviewApprovedFlash: Correction approved. It is now the authoritative count.
accountability.reviewRejectedFlash: Correction rejected. The previous approved count remains in force.
accountability.rejectionNoteRequired: Add a reason before rejecting the correction.
accountability.lockHint: A day can be submitted until {{hour}}:00 the next morning, then locks automatically.
accountability.evidenceHint: Up to 5 photos or receipts, JPEG/PNG/WebP/PDF, max 5 MB each. Files are hashed and append-only.
accountability.evidenceType: Attach a JPEG, PNG, WebP or PDF file.
accountability.evidenceTooLarge: Each file must be 5 MB or smaller.
accountability.evidenceLimit: You can attach at most {{count}} files.
accountability.evidenceUploadFailed: The count was saved, but {{count}} file(s) could not be uploaded.
accountability.successPendingReview: Correction submitted. An auditor must approve it before it replaces the current count.
